h.select_rule: Discard any hypothesis whose condition is the edited field's own current value, or whose condition merely disables or disconnects the edited component. From the rest, keep 10 with distinct mechanisms and field pairs, favouring those where an informed expert could plausibly bet on either direction.
h.strategy: Two patterns are banned because experts find them obvious: (1) conditioning on the current value of the same field being edited, which just restates that upgrading a weak setting helps more than upgrading a strong one; (2) conditions that make the edited component unused, unreachable or inert. Instead, each hypothesis must link two DIFFERENT fields that interact through a non-trivial mechanism, such as substitution between parallel routes, a capacity already supplied elsewhere, one part acting as a bottleneck for another, or interference that turns a usually helpful edit harmful. No condition setting may appear in more than two hypotheses. Use the gaps and negated assumptions as the source of each idea. In each 'why', name the mechanism and explain why the opposite direction is also a priori plausible.

hyps.why: A parallel identity route into node 3 already supplies trainability, so a conv on edge 4 is partly redundant.
A direct 3x3 conv from the input already supplies conv capacity at the output sum, so the serial-branch conv saturates.
Pool followed by conv3x3 on a serial chain stacks smoothing with overlapping receptive fields.
A parallel 3x3 conv into node 2 duplicates learned filters so a second conv on edge 0 adds diluted, redundant features.
A conv on edge 4 already gives the output a learned stream, so a conv into node 2 gives diminishing returns.
A conv on edge 4 already provides a strong trainable route, shrinking the identity's benefit.
Pooling right after a strong conv3x3 over-smooths the learned features and wastes their capacity.
With edge 4 as identity, node 1 goes straight to the output, so pooling on edge 0 leaves only a smoothed parameter-free signal on that route.
A skip on edge 1 leaves the 0->2 route without capacity, so a direct conv into the output supplies missing learned features.
With edge 4 removed, the direct input-to-output conv carries more of the network's capacity, so improving it matters more.
